palettes.name: Obsidian & Iris
palettes.judgment: Best balance of the journal and the instrument. Iris remains a reasoning signal; the identity rests on paper and obsidian.

palettes.name: Graphite & Mineral
palettes.character: Cooler, clearer, closer to the laboratory.
palettes.judgment: The strongest scientific register. Its colder paper and blue-leaning iris give up some literary warmth.

palettes.name: Ink & Parchment
palettes.character: Warmer, quieter, closer to a philosophical journal.
palettes.judgment: The strongest editorial register. Mauve and copper feel material; the computational character is less immediate.

reasoning.label: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Iris identifies the active reasoning operation.

exploration.label: Exploration
exploration.description: Cyan identifies a path being explored.

conflict.label: Conflict
conflict.description: Amber identifies a conflict that requires inspection.

insight.label: Candidate insight
insight.description: An amber event is a candidate to examine. A stable region can settle to chalk.

concentration.label: Concentration
concentration.description: Concentration uses neutral coherence rather than an additional hue.
